parrafo.es: Empaque, carga y mudanza local en Jacksonville, desde un piano hasta la casa completa. Un equipo directo, sin subcontratistas, que te avisa cada paso del camino.
parrafo.en: Packing, loading and local moving in Jacksonville, from a single piano to a full household. A direct team, no subcontractors, keeping you posted every step of the way.

parrafo_1.es: Jax Pro Movers ofrece servicios de mudanza residencial y comercial en Jacksonville desde 2021. Empaque, carga, transporte y descarga: un solo equipo que se ocupa de todo el proceso, sin intermediarios.
parrafo_1.en: Jax Pro Movers has offered residential and commercial moving services in Jacksonville since 2021. Packing, loading, transport and unloading: one team handling the whole process, no middlemen.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes destacan el cuidado con piezas delicadas, incluyendo pianos, y la puntualidad el día de la mudanza. Cada trabajo se coordina por teléfono o Facebook, directo con el equipo que hace el trabajo.
parrafo_2.en: Customers highlight the care we take with delicate pieces, including pianos, and being on time on moving day. Every job is coordinated by phone or Facebook, directly with the team doing the work.

texto.es: Llama, envía un mensaje de texto o escribe por Facebook. Nos cuentas qué te mudas y a dónde, y te damos un estimado.
texto.en: Call, text, or message us on Facebook. Tell us what you are moving and where, and we will give you an estimate.

texto.es: Coordinamos fecha, hora y qué necesita empaque especial, como pianos o piezas delicadas.
texto.en: We coordinate the date, the time, and what needs special packing, like pianos or delicate pieces.

texto.es: Envolvemos cada pieza con mantas y film protector, y cargamos con cuidado en el camión.
texto.en: We wrap every piece in moving blankets and protective film, and load the truck with care.

texto.es: Descargamos y acomodamos todo donde nos indiques. Tu mudanza, terminada sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We unload and set everything up where you tell us. Your move, finished with no surprises.

nota.es: Cada mudanza se cotiza según el tamaño y la distancia. Escríbenos para un presupuesto gratis.
nota.en: Every move is quoted based on size and distance. Message us for a free estimate.

texto.es: Mudanzas residenciales y comerciales dentro de Jacksonville, con un solo equipo de principio a fin.

texto.es: Transporte de pianos y otras piezas delicadas con el cuidado y las herramientas que requieren.
texto.en: Transport for pianos and other delicate pieces, with the care and the equipment they call for.

items.quote: Jax Pro Movers were excellent! They were available when I needed them and upon the day they arrived right on time and did the job diligently. They secured and transport my piano very professionally and with the utmost care. The owner and his helping hand were very friendly and nice. I would recommend them to anyone who wants to move.

Jax Pro Movers is nothing short of excellent. They are very responsive and professional. Dan is very courteous and went the extra mile to pickup and return the Uhaul cube needed to complete the process. While packing & unpacking I watched as they carefully arranged everything quickly.
